From f5b7acb59c4f2e88591aab9f355813e0b7b68db5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Julian Smith <jules@op59.net>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2020 17:08:12 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] Fix segv after memento squeeze in psdf_DCT_filter().

Fixes:
    MEMENTO_FAILAT=117152 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=../libbacktrace/.libs ./membin/gpdl -sDEVICE=bit -o /dev/null examples/tiger.eps
---
 devices/vector/gdevpsdu.c | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/devices/vector/gdevpsdu.c b/devices/vector/gdevpsdu.c
index c86405e..d626358 100644
--- a/devices/vector/gdevpsdu.c
+++ b/devices/vector/gdevpsdu.c
@@ -393,6 +393,8 @@ psdf_DCT_filter(gs_param_list *plist /* may be NULL */,
            &st_jpeg_compress_data, "zDCTE");
         if (jcdp == 0)
             return_error(gs_error_VMerror);
+        jcdp->cinfo.mem = NULL;
+        jcdp->cinfo.client_data = NULL;
         ss->data.compress = jcdp;
         jcdp->memory = ss->jpeg_memory = mem;	/* set now for allocation */
         if ((code = gs_jpeg_create_compress(ss)) < 0)
-- 
2.43.0
